authority.canonical_association: downstream exact producer and native session ID join to accepted session-context records
authority.materialization_policy: Project fields on canonical activities or dashboard rows are derived projections only; they must be reproducible from the accepted context record and the exact join keys and are never an independent resolver.

time_semantics.source_selection: The frozen eligible telemetry population uses authoritative source timestamps in an exact half-open range.
time_semantics.context_lookup: Context lookup is not limited to the telemetry range; it loads accepted records for each exact producer and native session ID.
time_semantics.lifecycle: Only true native lifecycle events create or transition context intervals. session_start opens an interval; workspace_changed closes and opens intervals at its timestamp; session_end closes an interval.
time_semantics.interval_boundary: Intervals are half-open: started_at <= source_time and source_time < ended_at when an end exists.
time_semantics.arrival_and_completion: Late arrival does not change effective lifecycle time. Completion-only evidence is a context event, not a lifecycle start; an authoritative project tuple delivered late may establish the exact producer/native-session mapping for earlier same-session telemetry only when exactly one project is unambiguous and no authoritative workspace transition exists. Conflicting mappings without authoritative transition evidence fail closed.

producer_capability_rule: Gate 1 approves the authority model while preserving unproven installed producer evidence as pending Gate 3. A producer is Supported only after installed-path lifecycle/context, source ingestion, exact identity join, and dashboard attribution proof; missing proof is not Unsupported.

commit_history.subject: feat: add deterministic session context attribution
commit_history.affected_responsibility: Introduced the shared runtime Git resolution and immutable session-context interval model for Codex app-server.
commit_history.finding: The initial boundary resolves the Git project in the shared runtime from a native lifecycle event, names the context by producer and session ID, and uses interval correlation.

commit_history.subject: refactor: centralize live session attribution
commit_history.affected_responsibility: Expanded the runtime producer and lifecycle contract and removed the session backfill path.
commit_history.finding: Live runtime context, rather than artifact backfill, became the sole intended attribution input; producer namespaces include Claude Code, Codex CLI, Codex app-server, and OMP.

commit_history.subject: feat: connect producer lifecycle hooks
commit_history.affected_responsibility: Added producer adapters and runtime validation for Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OMP.
commit_history.finding: Thin adapters forward native identity, workspace, event type, and occurrence time to the shared runtime; they do not resolve projects.

commit_history.subject: refactor: use session context for live attribution
commit_history.affected_responsibility: Moved project assignment into canonical activity construction and activity-version delivery.
commit_history.finding: This changed the downstream boundary by embedding project fields in canonical activity versions before dashboard delivery; Gate 1 approves those fields only as derived projections, not a second authority.

commit_history.subject: refactor: cut runtime to canonical activities
commit_history.affected_responsibility: Replaced broader runtime and evidence machinery with the canonical-activity baseline.
commit_history.finding: The cutover removed prior runtime paths but does not establish canonical project authority outside the shared session-context runtime.

commit_history.subject: refactor: establish clean canonical baseline
commit_history.affected_responsibility: Reset the canonical schema and fresh-start baseline.
commit_history.finding: The clean baseline is implementation history, not a new project resolver or a replacement for exact producer/session association.

commit_history.subject: fix: complete canonical ingestion cutover
commit_history.affected_responsibility: Completed ingestion cutover and expanded Codex CLI source service and thread-ID handling.
commit_history.finding: Codex CLI source identity accepts thread.id or thread_id, but retained proof remains insufficient to claim installed-path attribution coverage.

commit_history.subject: fix: enforce canonical temporal invariants
commit_history.affected_responsibility: Added ordered lifecycle replay, immutable rejection identity, and interval reconstruction safeguards.
commit_history.finding: The interval model is ordered and half-open, supports true workspace transitions, and rejects invalid lifecycle transitions; it does not authorize completion callbacks as starts.

commit_history.subject: fix: map Codex notify only to session start
commit_history.affected_responsibility: Removed Codex CLI adapter state and mapped every agent-turn-complete callback to session_start; this former behavior is rejected as a synthetic lifecycle start.
commit_history.finding: agent-turn-complete occurs after source telemetry and repeated callbacks must remain completion-context events, not starts; its authoritative project tuple may restore the exact producer/session mapping for earlier same-session telemetry only when one project is unambiguous and no authoritative workspace transition exists. Conflicts fail closed.

installed_entry_points.evidence_gap: Retained proof records unequal explicit and hook session IDs and disabled source ingestion; installed CwdChanged policy, exact identity join, remote delivery, and dashboard attribution remain unproven.

Retained direct identity proof bypasses the active Computer Use notify chain; agent-turn-complete is completion-only, never a lifecycle start. Its authoritative project tuple may establish the exact producer/session mapping for earlier same-session telemetry only when exactly one project is unambiguous and no authoritative workspace transition exists; conflicting mappings fail closed. Repeated callback behavior, installed execution, exact join, remote delivery, and dashboard attribution remain unproven.
Retained protocol proof establishes identity equality and namespace isolation, but no fresh installed end-to-end dashboard proof exists; end and workspace-change behavior are unproven.

installed_entry_points.adapter_runtime_path: independent Codex app surface; no adapter/runtime path proven
installed_entry_points.evidence_gap: Codex app is independent of Codex app-server. Workspace lifecycle identity equality and source ingestion are unproven and must not be silently inherited from app-server evidence.

installed_entry_points.callback: native extension session_start and session_shutdown callbacks
installed_entry_points.evidence_gap: Retained fixture names both identity fields but does not retain observed equal values; installed extension execution, source ingestion, exact join, remote delivery, dashboard attribution, concurrency, and restart proof remain pending Gate 3.
